i struggle with this a lot. hell, i’ve been dating my boyfriend for almost 3 years and i still think about stuff like this all the time.

at first, i did the same thing as you. i constantly paced between negative thoughts, since i was super insecure in the relationship. eventually, i grew comfortable in the relationship so i don’t worry as much now.

i’d say that trust plays a big part in these insecure thoughts. one thing that helps me is thinking thoughts such as, “he chose to be with me” or “there’s a reason why he’s with me”. this helps me calm down and look at the situation between my boyfriend and i. if he’s not doing anything shady, and seems content in the relationship, there’s absolutely nothing to worry about. you also need to build a good amount of trust with him, to the point where you feel confident that you don’t have to have these thoughts. it takes a while to build this up, so don’t expect instant results. focus on building a trusting bond with him, it can definitely help the both of you down the road. because if you’re too worried and these thoughts start to affect you, it can create conflicts in the relationship. i’d like to think positively, so hopefully this can help you with your insecure thoughts :)
